1.text: Yesu yuzuzwa Umwuka Wera, ava kuri Yorodani ajyanwa n'Umwuka mu butayu,

2.text: amarayo iminsi mirongo ine ageragezwa n'Umwanzi. Muri iyo minsi ntiyagira icyo arya, nuko ishize arasonza.

3.text: Umwanzi aramubwira ati “Niba uri Umwana w'Imana, bwira iri buye rihinduke umutsima.”

4.text: Yesu aramusubiza ati “Handitswe ngo ‘Umuntu ntatungwa n'umutsima gusa.’ ”

5.text: Umwanzi aramuzamura amwereka ubwami bwose bwo mu isi mu kanya gato,

6.text: aramubwira ati “Ndaguha ubu butware bwose n'ikuzo ryabwo, kuko ari jye wabugabanye kandi mbugabira uwo nshaka wese.

7.text: Nuko numpfukamira ukandamya, buriya bwose buraba ubwawe.”

8.text: Yesu aramusubiza ati “Handitswe ngo ‘Uramye Uwiteka Imana yawe, abe ari yo ukorera yonyine.’ ”

9.text: Amujyana i Yerusalemu, amuhagarika ku gasongero k'urusengero aramubwira ati “Niba uri Umwana w'Imana, ijugunye hasi

10.text: kuko handitswe ngo ‘Izagutegekera abamarayika bayo bakurinde’,

11.text: kandi ngo ‘Bazakuramira mu maboko yabo ngo udakubita ikirenge ku ibuye.’ ”

12.text: Yesu aramusubiza ati “Haravuzwe ngo ‘Ntukagerageze Uwiteka Imana yawe.’ ”

13.text: Umwanzi arangije ibyo amugerageresha byose aramureka, amutega ikindi gihe.

14.text: Yesu asubira i Galilaya afite imbaraga z'Umwuka, inkuru ye yamamara mu bihugu byose bihereranye n'aho.

15.text: Yigishiriza mu masinagogi yabo, bose baramuhimbaza.

16.text: Ajya i Nazareti iyo yarerewe, ku munsi w'isabato yinjira mu isinagogi nk'uko yamenyereye, arahagarara ngo asome.

17.text: Bamuha igitabo cy'umuhanuzi Yesaya, arakibumbura abona igice cyanditswemo ngo

18.text: “Umwuka w'Uwiteka ari muri jye,Ni cyo cyatumye ansīgira,Kugira ngo mbwirize abakene ubutumwa bwiza.Yantumye kumenyesha imbohe ko zibohorwa,N'impumyi ko zihumuka,No kubohora ibisenzegeri,

19.text: No kumenyesha abantu iby'umwaka Umwami agiriyemo imbabazi.”

20.text: Amaze kubumba igitabo agisubiza umurinzi w'inzu, aricara. Abantu bose bari mu isinagogi baramutumbira.

21.text: Nuko atangira kubabwira ati “Uyu munsi ibyo byanditswe bisohoye mu matwi yanyu.”

22.text: Bose baramushima, batangazwa n'amagambo meza avuye mu kanwa ke bati “Mbese aho uyu si we mwene Yosefu?”

23.text: Arababwira ati “Ntimuzabura kunciraho uyu mugani muti ‘Muvuzi, wivure. Ibyo twumvise byose ko wakoze i Kaperinawumu, bikore n'ino mu mudugudu wanyu.’ ”

24.text: Arababwira ati “Ndababwira ukuri yuko ari nta muhanuzi wemerwa iwabo.

25.text: “Ariko ndababwira ukuri yuko hāriho abapfakazi benshi mu Bisirayeli mu gihe cya Eliya, ubwo ijuru ryakingwaga imyaka itatu n'amezi atandatu, inzara nyinshi igatera mu gihugu cyose.

26.text: Nyamara Eliya ntiyatumwa kuri umwe muri bo, ahubwo atumwa ku mugore w'umupfakazi w'i Sarefati mu gihugu cy'i Sidoni.

27.text: Kandi hāriho ababembe benshi mu Bisirayeli mu gihe cy'umuhanuzi Elisa, nyamara ntihakizwa n'umwe muri bo keretse Nāmani w'Umusiriya.”

28.text: Abo mu isinagogi bose babyumvise batyo bagira umujinya mwinshi,

29.text: barahaguruka bamwirukana mu mudugudu, bamugeza ku manga y'umusozi batuyeho bashaka kuyimutembagazamo,

31.text: Aramanuka ajya i Kaperinawumu, umudugudu w'i Galilaya, abigisha ku isabato.

32.text: Batangazwa no kwigisha kwe, kuko ijambo rye ryari rifite ubushobozi.

33.text: Nuko mu isinagogi harimo umuntu utewe na dayimoni, atakambira Yesu ati

34.text: “Ayii we! Duhuriye he Yesu w'i Nazareti? Uje kuturimbura? Ndakuzi uri Uwera w'Imana.”

35.text: Yesu aramucyaha ati “Hora muvemo.” Dayimoni amutura hasi hagati yabo, amuvamo atagize icyo amutwara.

36.text: Bose barumirwa barabazanya bati “Mbega rino jambo ni jambo ki? Arategekesha abadayimoni ubutware n'ububasha bakavamo!”

37.text: Inkuru ye yamamara hose mu gihugu gihereranye n'aho.

38.text: Arahaguruka asohoka mu isinagogi, yinjira mu nzu ya Simoni. Nyirabukwe wa Simoni yari arwaye ubuganga bwinshi, nuko baramumwingingira.

39.text: Amuhagarara iruhande acyaha ubuganga bumuvamo, muri ako kanya arahaguruka arabagaburira.

40.text: Nuko izuba rigiye kurenga, abafite abarwayi bose barwaye indwara zitari zimwe barabamuzanira. Abarambikaho ibiganza umwe umwe arabakiza.

41.text: Kandi n'abadayimoni bava muri benshi bataka bati “Uri Umwana w'Imana.”Arabacyaha, ababuza kuvuga kuko bari bazi yuko ari Kristo.

42.text: Bukeye ajya mu butayu, abantu benshi baramushaka bagera aho ari, bashaka kumubuza ngo atava muri bo.

43.text: Ariko arababwira ati “Nkwiriye kwigisha ubutumwa bwiza bw'Imana no mu yindi midugudu, kuko ari ibyo natumiwe.”

44.text: Nuko yigishiriza mu masinagogi y'i Galilaya.
